title: Canonical derived scalar Hom equivalence
statement: The derived scalar extension and exact restriction admit an equivalence of Hom sets whose value on a morphism f is adicReductionDerivedUnit ≫ Res.map f.

proof.text: Construct the ordinary sheaf scalar extension and restriction adjunction from the tensor unit. Restriction is exact, so the derived adjunction exists and its left derived functor is computed on the K-flat model by adicChange and localization. The derived unit is the displayed adicReductionDerivedUnit, by its representative tensor formula. Transporting the derived Hom equivalence along the chosen realization gives the stated e and formula.
